post_hoc_notes: P1 by layer: layer 0 median error 0.111 (25% within 0.03), layer 1 72%, layers 2-15 85-93% within 0.03 (excluding layers 0-1 the 90% bar is roughly met; post hoc, NOT the preregistered verdict). P2 detail: the 11 decayed dependent nets need k_free = 64 (8 nets) or 16 (2 nets) vs k_init = 16; k=64 restores >= 0.95 x full accuracy, i.e. extraction works at ~4x the init-based minimal rank, failing the preregistered max(2*k_init,32)=32 criterion. Undecayed dependent nets (43): k_free median 256-512 vs k_init 16-32 despite r_hat 6-12 outliers; outlier count does not predict extraction (P4 rho 0.26).
